$comment: Tests CI skips on the GitHub runner, each named EXACTLY (no prefixes: a future test with a similar name is never quarantined by accident). tools/ci_quarantine.py prints this inventory, fails the run when an entry has passed its review date, and emits the exact --skip arguments. Remove an entry once its planner expectation is machine-independent. The 11 September 2026 audit's ZIPP-15.

policy.expiry: An entry whose review_by date has passed fails CI until it is reviewed: either the fix landed and the entry is removed, or the date is moved with a fresh observation recorded here.
policy.scope: x86-64 register-tier MECHANISM assertions (planner/emitter fixtures) only. Semantic equivalence tests are never quarantined; the parity tests in the same binaries run and pass on the runner.
